{{Quote|Take grav-tube ''down 53B'' to level 4! Exit to cargo-tube ''ZZ8''!|Instructions to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="GW">"[[Gambler's World]]"</ref>}}
A '''grav tube''' was a means of personnel conveyance between decks aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. By manipulating a [[microgravity]] control, a user would adjust the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] within the tube, enabling them to float up or down to reach another deck. The [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] used grav tubes.<ref name="TRG1-17" /> Grav tubes were also used in multi-level cities on planets like [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]] to travel between levels.<ref name="GW" />
